name: erisreader
description: Read PDFs and talk their passages through with ErisHarness agents, in the margin

scripts.build: npm run build:agents && node scripts/pdfjs-assets.mjs && vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && vite build
scripts.build:agents: cargo build --release --manifest-path agents/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p out/agents && cp agents/target/release/erisreader-agents out/agents/
scripts.test: npm run test:agents && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build && E2E_HEADED=1 playwright test
